biology: 寄主记录为悬铃木（Platanus acerifolia）。
en: Soldier. Head yellowish brown with a reddish cast, elongate cylindrical, the sides nearly parallel and only slightly constricted at mid-length; the hind margin is broadly rounded. In profile the dorsolateral frontal corners are barely raised, the frontal slope is about forty-five degrees and the dorsal margin of the head is almost straight. Eyes large and prominent, the distance to the antennal socket less than the eye's short diameter. Labrum semicircular; mandibles slender and curved at the tip, the left about half the head length. Antennae eleven to twelve segmented, the third shortest. Postmentum seven to eight times as long as the waist breadth. Pronotum slightly wider than the widest part of the head, its fore margin with a broad shallow V-shaped emargination and a distinct mid-line.
soldier: 兵蚁头壳黄褐带红，上颚紫褐，上唇、触角与前胸背板同为黄褐，腹部淡黄，足色更浅，腿节与胫节淡黄而跗节偏黄。头壳作长圆柱形，两侧大致平行，仅中段略收，后缘宽圆；侧面观额顶背角几乎不隆起，额坡约四十五度，头背缘接近平直，额面平展，Y形缝可辨；复眼大而外凸，其与触角窝的距离不及眼之短径。上唇半圆，上颚端部细且弯曲，左上颚约为头壳长度的一半。触角十一至十二节，第三节最短。后颏甚长，约为腰宽的七至八倍，最宽处在前面三分之一，腰区自中部起平行后伸。前胸背板宽度略大于头壳最宽处，前缘有宽广的V形浅凹，两侧近平行，后缘外凸而中央浅切，中纵线清晰。
